title: CallContext: cluster and project
description: How calls know which cluster's project they operate on.
body: Where a call is happening: which cluster asked, and what that cluster is working on. This is the thing an app's Rust half could not previously know. A struct rather than a bare Option<PathBuf> because it is going to grow: Cluster::worktree is carried in the layout already and joins this as worktree: Option<WorktreeRef> when git work lands.
